hypothesis: During an intact 50-session uptrend, a T-1 true range no greater than 0.75 times the prior 14-session ATR together with a close in the upper quartile indicates constrained selling and incomplete information diffusion. Buying the next open and exiting at open plus 0.25 ATR, or at the same-session close if unfilled, should add repeatable net return across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500 after the user-specified fee without overnight risk.

fixed one-third combined CAGR >= CNY cash CAGR +2.00 percentage points
fixed one-third combined Sharpe > C-COMPRESSION-COMBINED Sharpe

selection_metric: No within-family selection. There is exactly one cross-asset rule; all three standalone paths, the fixed one-third combined path, matched controls and execution stress are reported, and PASS requires every preregistered gate.
